# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)

## Overview
This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.

## Data Source

### tariff_rates
Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.

### bilateral_trade
Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).

### supply_chain_share
Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.

### policy_events
Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.

## Data Notes
- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Color palette - editorial, muted but distinct
C_US = '#1b4f72'
C_CN = '#c0392b'
C_VN = '#27ae60'
C_IN = '#e67e22'
C_TRADE = '#2c3e50'
C_EVENT_BG = '#fdf2e9'
C_GRID = '#d5d8dc'
C_ANNO = '#7f8c8d'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#555555',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 16), facecolor='white')
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics, 2016–2024',
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color='#1a1a1a')
fig.text(0.5, 0.953,
         'Tariff Escalation, Bilateral Trade Shifts, and Supply Chain Diversification',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, hspace=0.35, top=0.93, bottom=0.06, left=0.09, right=0.88)

# --- Panel 1: Tariff Rates with Policy Event Annotations ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
tariff = data['tariff_rates']['data']
periods = [d['period'] for d in tariff]
x_idx = np.arange(len(periods))
us_t = [d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff]
cn_t = [d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff]

ax1.step(x_idx, us_t, where='mid', color=C_US, linewidth=2.2, label='US tariff on China')
ax1.step(x_idx, cn_t, where='mid', color=C_CN, linewidth=2.2, label='China tariff on US')
ax1.fill_between(x_idx, us_t, alpha=0.08, step='mid', color=C_US)
ax1.fill_between(x_idx, cn_t, alpha=0.08, step='mid', color=C_CN)

ax1.set_ylabel('Avg. Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Stepwise Tariff Escalation with Key Policy Events', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xticks(x_idx)
ax1.set_xticklabels(periods, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=7.5)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 30)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(5))
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)

# Annotate policy events
events = data['policy_events']['data']
period_to_x = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(periods)}
cat_colors = {'investigation': '#8e44ad', 'tariff': C_CN, 'deal': C_VN, 'review': C_IN}
anno_y_offsets = [27, 25.5, 27, 25.5, 27, 25.5, 27, 25.5, 27, 25.5, 27, 25.5]

for i, ev in enumerate(events):
    px = period_to_x.get(ev['period_approx'])
    if px is None:
        continue
    short = ev['event']
    if len(short) > 40:
        short = short[:38] + '…'
    y_off = anno_y_offsets[i % len(anno_y_offsets)]
    color = cat_colors.get(ev['category'], C_ANNO)
    ax1.annotate(short, xy=(px, max(us_t[px], cn_t[px])),
                 xytext=(px, y_off),
                 fontsize=5.5, color=color, ha='center', va='bottom',
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=0.6),
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', ec=color, alpha=0.85, lw=0.4))

cat_handles = [Line2D([0],[0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=v, markersize=5, label=k.title())
               for k, v in cat_colors.items()]
leg2 = ax1.legend(handles=cat_handles, loc='center left', fontsize=7, title='Event Type',
                  title_fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.9, bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.5))
ax1.add_artist(ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9))

# --- Panel 2: Bilateral Trade Volume ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
bt = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
years = [d['year'] for d in bt]
exports = [d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in bt]
imports = [d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in bt]
total = [d['total_bilateral'] for d in bt]

width = 0.35
x2 = np.arange(len(years))
bars_exp = ax2.bar(x2 - width/2, exports, width, color=C_US, alpha=0.85, label='US Exports to China')
bars_imp = ax2.bar(x2 + width/2, imports, width, color=C_CN, alpha=0.85, label='US Imports from China')
ax2.plot(x2, total, color=C_TRADE, linewidth=2.5, marker='o', markersize=5,
         label='Total Bilateral Trade', zorder=5)

# Shade peak tariff dip period
ax2.axvspan(x2[years.index(2019)] - 0.5, x2[years.index(2020)] + 0.5,
            alpha=0.07, color=C_CN, label='Peak Tariff Period')

for i, t in enumerate(total):
    ax2.text(x2[i], t + 10, f'${t:.0f}B', ha='center', fontsize=7, color=C_TRADE, fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_ylabel('Trade Volume (Billion USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('US–China Bilateral Trade Volume', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(x2)
ax2.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 780)
ax2.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

# --- Panel 3: Supply Chain Diversification ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
sc = data['supply_chain_share']['data']
years3 = [d['year'] for d in sc]
china_sh = [d['china'] for d in sc]
vn_sh = [d['vietnam'] for d in sc]
in_sh = [d['india'] for d in sc]
x3 = np.arange(len(years3))

ax3.plot(x3, china_sh, color=C_CN, linewidth=2.5, marker='s', markersize=6, label='China')
ax3.plot(x3, vn_sh, color=C_VN, linewidth=2.5, marker='^', markersize=6, label='Vietnam')
ax3.plot(x3, in_sh, color=C_IN, linewidth=2.5, marker='D', markersize=5, label='India')

ax3.fill_between(x3, china_sh, alpha=0.1, color=C_CN)
ax3.fill_between(x3, vn_sh, alpha=0.1, color=C_VN)
ax3.fill_between(x3, in_sh, alpha=0.1, color=C_IN)

# Mark 2018 threshold
ax3.axvline(x3[years3.index(2018)], color='#555', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax3.text(x3[years3.index(2018)] + 0.1, 20, 'Trade war\nbegins', fontsize=7, color='#555', style='italic')

# Arrow showing China decline
ax3.annotate('', xy=(x3[-1], china_sh[-1]), xytext=(x3[1], china_sh[1]),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_CN, lw=1.5, ls='--', alpha=0.4))
ax3.annotate(f'China: {china_sh[1]}% → {china_sh[-1]}%',
             xy=(x3[4], 15.5), fontsize=8, color=C_CN, fontweight='bold')

# Arrow showing Vietnam rise
ax3.annotate(f'Vietnam: {vn_sh[0]}% → {vn_sh[-1]}%',
             xy=(x3[5], 4.2), fontsize=8, color=C_VN, fontweight='bold')
ax3.annotate(f'India: {in_sh[0]}% → {in_sh[-1]}%',
             xy=(x3[5], 2.0), fontsize=8, color=C_IN, fontweight='bold')

ax3.set_ylabel('Share of US Imports (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Supply Chain Diversification: Rising Alternatives to China', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticks(x3)
ax3.set_xticklabels(years3, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 25)
ax3.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(5))
ax3.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax3.legend(fontsize=9, loc='right', framealpha=0.9)

# Source note
fig.text(0.09, 0.015,
         'Source: Compiled from USTR, USITC, US Census Bureau trade statistics. 2024 figures are H1 estimates.',
         fontsize=7, color='#999999', style='italic')

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 18), facecolor='white')
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics, 2016–2024',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color='#1a1a1a')
fig.text(0.5, 0.96,
         'Tariff Escalation, Bilateral Trade Shifts, and Supply Chain Diversification',
         ha='center', fontsize=12, color='#555555')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, hspace=0.38, top=0.94, bottom=0.05, left=0.08, right=0.82)

# ── Panel 1: Tariff Rates ──
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
tariff = data['tariff_rates']['data']
periods = [d['period'] for d in tariff]
x_idx = np.arange(len(periods))
us_t = [d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff]
cn_t = [d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff]

ax1.step(x_idx, us_t, where='mid', color=C_US, linewidth=2.4, label='US Tariff on China', zorder=3)
ax1.step(x_idx, cn_t, where='mid', color=C_CN, linewidth=2.4, label='China Tariff on US', zorder=3)
ax1.fill_between(x_idx, us_t, alpha=0.07, step='mid', color=C_US)
ax1.fill_between(x_idx, cn_t, alpha=0.07, step='mid', color=C_CN)

ax1.set_ylabel('Avg. Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=10.5)
ax1.set_title('Stepwise Tariff Escalation with Key Policy Events', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax1.set_xticks(x_idx)
ax1.set_xticklabels(periods, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 30)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(5))
ax1.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9.5, framealpha=0.95)

# Policy event annotations - placed in right margin
events = data['policy_events']['data']
period_to_x = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(periods)}
cat_colors = {'investigation': '#8e44ad', 'tariff': C_CN, 'deal': C_VN, 'review': C_IN}
cat_symbols = {'investigation': '◆', 'tariff': '●', 'deal': '★', 'review': '▲'}

# Group events and place annotations on the right side
selected_events = [
    (0, "Section 301 Investigation"),
    (1, "Section 301 Memo ($50B)"),
    (2, "List 1: 25% on $34B"),
    (3, "List 2: 25% on $16B"),
    (4, "List 3: 10% on $200B"),
    (5, "List 3 raised to 25%"),
    (6, "List 4A: 15% on $112B"),
    (7, "Phase One Deal Signed"),
    (8, "Phase One reductions"),
    (9, "USTR tariff review"),
    (10, "Biden tariff exclusions"),
    (11, "Biden raises tariffs (EVs, chips)"),
]

for i, (idx, label) in enumerate(selected_events):
    ev = events[idx]
    px = period_to_x.get(ev['period_approx'])
    if px is None:
        continue
    color = cat_colors.get(ev['category'], C_ANNO)
    sym = cat_symbols.get(ev['category'], '●')
    y_val = max(us_t[px], cn_t[px])
    ax1.plot(px, y_val, marker='v', color=color, markersize=5, zorder=5, clip_on=False)

# Place event legend on the right
event_text_lines = []
for i, (idx, label) in enumerate(selected_events):
    ev = events[idx]
    color = cat_colors.get(ev['category'], C_ANNO)
    sym = cat_symbols.get(ev['category'], '●')
    date_short = ev['date'][:7]

fig.text(0.835, y_start - len(event_text_lines) * 0.019 - 0.01,
         cat_legend_text, fontsize=7, color='#777', transform=fig.transFigure)

ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
bt = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
years = [d['year'] for d in bt]
exports = [d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in bt]
imports = [d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in bt]
total = [d['total_bilateral'] for d in bt]

ax2.bar(x2 + width/2, imports, width, color=C_CN, alpha=0.85, label='US Imports from China')
ax2.plot(x2, total, color=C_TRADE, linewidth=2.5, marker='o', markersize=6,
         label='Total Bilateral Trade', zorder=5)

dip_start = x2[years.index(2019)] - 0.5
dip_end = x2[years.index(2020)] + 0.5
ax2.axvspan(dip_start, dip_end, alpha=0.08, color=C_CN, zorder=0)
ax2.text((dip_start + dip_end)/2, 740, 'Peak Tariff\nPeriod', ha='center',
         fontsize=8, color=C_CN, style='italic', alpha=0.7)

for i, t in enumerate(total):
    ax2.text(x2[i], t + 12, f'${t:.0f}B', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color=C_TRADE, fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_ylabel('Trade Volume (Billion USD)', fontsize=10.5)
ax2.set_title('US–China Bilateral Trade Volume', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax2.set_xticks(x2)
ax2.set_xticklabels(years, fontsize=9.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 780)
ax2.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.95, ncol=1)

# ── Panel 3: Supply Chain Diversification ──
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
sc = data['supply_chain_share']['data']

china_sh = [d['china'] for d in sc]
vn_sh = [d['vietnam'] for d in sc]
in_sh = [d['india'] for d in sc]
x3 = np.arange(len(years3))

ax3.plot(x3, china_sh, color=C_CN, linewidth=2.8, marker='s', markersize=7, label='China', zorder=3)
ax3.plot(x3, vn_sh, color=C_VN, linewidth=2.8, marker='^', markersize=7, label='Vietnam', zorder=3)
ax3.plot(x3, in_sh, color=C_IN, linewidth=2.8, marker='D', markersize=6, label='India', zorder=3)

ax3.fill_between(x3, china_sh, alpha=0.08, color=C_CN)
ax3.fill_between(x3, vn_sh, alpha=0.08, color=C_VN)
ax3.fill_between(x3, in_sh, alpha=0.08, color=C_IN)

# 2018 trade war line
tw_x = x3[years3.index(2018)]
ax3.axvline(tw_x, color='#555', linewidth=1, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
ax3.text(tw_x + 0.15, 23.5, 'Trade war begins', fontsize=8.5, color='#555', style='italic')

# Delta annotations
ax3.annotate(f'China: {china_sh[0]}% → {china_sh[-1]}%  (−{china_sh[0]-china_sh[-1]:.1f} pp)',
             xy=(x3[-1], china_sh[-1]), xytext=(x3[-1]+0.3, china_sh[-1]+1.5),

ax3.annotate(f'Vietnam: {vn_sh[0]}% → {vn_sh[-1]}%  (+{vn_sh[-1]-vn_sh[0]:.1f} pp)',
